sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial (hydrolysed soy) that began May 18, and chicken was logged on 29 of 154 meals and treats, with at least 4 off-list, the last on Jun 27.
Dentastix, whose label lists chicken, were fed daily from Jun 8 and are on the owner-entered allowed list; no chicken-free day is recorded since Jun 8.

Itching has 16 entries on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days, and this record is not a test of the diet, with Apoquel (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlapping the trial.
The owner wrote “flare after the chicken on Sunday”, Sunday being Jun 14; this is not tested, as chicken was fed daily from Jun 8.
